esp32_robot_1.name: Robot Tham Hiem (ESP32-CAM)
esp32_robot_1._note: AUDIT-ARM-01: board nay (ESP32-CAM, myiris_robot.yaml) chi con 1 servo 'turret' xoay camera (khong phai canh tay 4 khop day du) - ESP32-CAM khong con du GPIO trong cho shoulder/elbow/gripper. has_arm=false de UI khong hien 3 slider khong co tac dung that. Muon dieu khien canh tay day du, dung entry 'esp32_arm_1' ben duoi (board rieng, xem myiris_arm.yaml).
